title: Governance Constraint Artifact
description: Canonical attributable, versioned, integrity-protected representation of a governance constraint. DS-007 preserves source lineage, deterministic constraint semantics, protected or constitutional classification, Governance Configuration binding, compilation and validation evidence, Governance Version, Controlled Governance Activation, and non-weakening semantics without itself establishing authority at commitment, determining Commit-Bound Admissibility, authorizing execution, activating governance, or committing a transition.

constraint_artifact_id.description: Stable DS-007 Governance Constraint Artifact identifier.

constraint_type.description: Constraint type registered in the applicable constraint-type registry.

constraint_artifact_ref.description: Integrity-bound reference to a DS-007 Governance Constraint Artifact.

constraint_source_representation.description: Canonical source representation of the constraint before Governance Compilation.

compilation_projection.description: Integrity-bound projection of the authoritative DS-042 compilation and validation record. This projection does not replace DS-042.

namespaced_extensions.description: Namespaced non-normative extensions. Extensions cannot alter canonical constraint meaning.
